Validate tool suggestion install URLs before showing the app link (#48015)

## Why

Tool suggestions could pass unchecked `install_url` values to the app link view for opening in a browser.

## What changed

Reuse the external URL validator to require HTTPS URLs with a host and no embedded credentials. Decline suggestions with invalid URLs on the requesting thread without showing a popup.

## Testing

Add a regression test covering malformed URLs, unsupported schemes, embedded credentials, and a valid HTTPS URL. Verify that rejected suggestions leave the popup unchanged and resolve on the requesting thread, while the valid URL opens on confirmation.
